name: Honor Roll
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps play Méliès U: Only the Brightest (Vantage Point Stage 8), a secret identity of three reverse sides that flips when the Runner makes a successful run on a central server. Jinteki and neutral cards the other Jinteki deck leaves out — Diviner, Mycoweb, Empiricist, Semak-samun, Peer Review, Mitra Aman, Anoetic Void — with Hansei Review and Longevity Serum to fill Archives for the back sides to draw on. Eternal-legal only. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 1: two Boto for two Enigma. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 4a: two Cohort Guidance Program and a Charlotte Caçador for two Regolith Mining License and an Unleash. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 7d: two Sisyphus Protocol for two Proprionegation, an agenda for an agenda. The Automata Initiative Stage 8b: two Adrian Seis for its two Mahkota Langit Grid, and two Daniela Jorge Inácio for its two Empiricist, which other decks still carry. Parhelion Stage 5b: two Hybrid Release for its two Superconducting Hub, a point each, and two Nanisivik Grid for its two Mitra Aman: the discards and trashes of a Jinteki deck fill Archives with facedown cards for both.
